title.en: Releasing Appropriated Funds to the National Coal Authority as Government Equity Contribution
title.orig: Releasing Appropriated Funds to the National Coal Authority as Government Equity Contribution

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation
source.url: LawPhil (source has HTML full text only)

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 EO_00686_1981_html.txt

text.en:
That the National Coal Authority shall have an initial authorized capitalization in the amount of Five
Hundred Million Pesos divided into five hundred thousand shares with a par value of P1,000 per share to be
wholly subscribed by the Philippine government.

That as initial paid-up equity contribution of the government and pursuant to Letter of Instruction No.
1103, the amount of Fifty Million Pesos is hereby directed to be released to the National Coal Authority out of
the Special Fund created under Section 8(j) of R.A. No. 6173, as amended.

That the Board of Governors may from time to time and as the operations and objectives of the
National Coal Authority require, increase the capitalization of the Authority.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, Philippines, this 5th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
